description: Native macOS-style desktop shell and built-in apps for Windows 11
pre_uninstall:
$runningNames = @(
    'WacOSShell', 'WacOSFinder', 'WacOSSettings', 'WacOSActivityMonitor', 'WacOSTerminal',
    'WacOSCalculator', 'WacOSNotes', 'WacOSScreenshot', 'WacOSPreview', 'WacOSReminders',
    'WacOSCalendar', 'WacOSTextEdit', 'WacOSClock', 'WacOSWeather', 'WacOSContacts',
    'WacOSPhotos', 'WacOSTimeMachine', 'WacOSMusic', 'WacOSQuickTime', 'WacOSForceQuit',
    'SequoiaShell'
)
$running = @(Get-Process -Name $runningNames -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
if ($running.Count -gt 0) {
    $names = ($running.ProcessName | Sort-Object -Unique) -join ', '
    throw "Close WacOS and its apps before uninstalling/updating. Exit the shell with Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F12 (emergency exit: Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F11). Still running: $names"
}
notes: Requires Windows 11 22H2 or newer. While running, WacOS hides the Windows taskbar and adjusts the desktop work area; it restores them when the shell exits. Use Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F12 to exit or Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F11 for emergency exit.
User settings are stored by the upstream app in %APPDATA%\Shell; they are not redirected into Scoop persist.
